description:
## Problem
DataFrame runs report a clean validation pass only where a row-count reference exists. On develop (2026-11-17) that covers TPC-H SF 0.01, 0.1 and unseeded SF 1, SSB at recorded scales, and TPC-DS at the subscale reference seed. TPC-H above SF 1, TPC-DS at SF 1 and above outside the subscale table, ClickBench, and other DataFrame benchmarks still report UNCERTAIN or NOT_RUN, so their correctness rests on the cross-surface gate against DuckDB SQL. Seeded TPC-H SF 1 is tracked separately in seeded-dataframe-tpch-sf1-has-no-row-count-validation-20261117.

## Evidence
`_reference_unavailable_reason` and `_apply_reference_row_counts` in benchbox/core/dataframe/query_validation.py; the original description (Polars matrix follow-up) predates #3068 and #4269.

## Decision gate (owner)
Pick the next combinations and the oracle for each: reuse the SQL `QueryValidator` answer sets where they exist (TPC-DS SF 1, TPC-H SF 10+ where answers exist), recorded row-count tables, or result-hash references. Record the list in context before implementing; one benchmark per PR.

## Change
Add the chosen providers so those combinations report PASSED or FAILED.

## Guardrails
- Unsupported combinations keep reporting UNCERTAIN or NOT_RUN; never default to PASSED.
- References are generated by a make target, not hand-edited, and record their engine and parameters.
- No change to SQL validation or the submission validator.

## Verification rubric
Pass only if each newly supported combination has a test with a correct and an incorrect count, a real run of that combination stages and passes validate_submission.py, and the supported matrix is documented.
